# TimePicker { #anylumino.TimePicker }

```python
TimePicker(
    value=None,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
)
```

Time picker control.

The frontend renders a native time input with an anylumino popup picker. The
popup shows hours and minutes in separate columns, so users can pick any minute
value instead of being limited to fixed 15-minute increments.

Python `datetime.time` values are accepted and serialized with `isoformat()`
before syncing to the frontend.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                            | Default   |
|-------------|----------|----------------------------------------|-----------|
| value | `datetime.time`, `str`, or `None` | Initial value and synced Python value. Strings should use `HH:MM` or another browser-compatible time value. | `None` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.TimePicker.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
